big: Nifty Oil & Gas is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

h: What is the Nifty Oil & Gas?
lines: What does the Nifty Oil & Gas track?
The Nifty Oil & Gas Index is designed to reflect the behaviour and performance of the companies belonging to Oil, Gas and Petroleum industry. It holds 15 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
